desc: We can track the wounded Giant Rat King by following its footprints. We need to get enough of its blood for the antidote.
The Herb Garden is surrounded by rats, making it impossible for me to start construction.
What are we waiting for? Let's try it!
There are quite a lot of strong fellows in our town. You can recruit them at any time!
Countless lives have been taken by the Black Wizard's black rats and Blight. Wish I could eliminate them now!
There are still many hidden dangers deep in the forest. We need to continue exploring...
Fortunately, I met Grenwald, or I would have met my late grandmother.
Aah!!!
Celia! Hold on!
I can't wait to experience it firsthand!
No, you won't! Doctor, please save my father! I'm begging you!
Some people are too sick to walk. We'll send carts to bring them in.
All wounded soldiers will enter the Infirmary for treatment.
The ward has been arranged with equipment specifically for treating wounded soldiers.
Let me help rebuild this town!
Everyone, pick up the pace! Hurry up!
Thank you so much! You're our last hope!
I can see light of a fire! Move quickly!
Absolutely perfect, it's even more sturdy than before! Doctor, come in and grab a drink!
Don't worry, Doctor. The search function will show you exactly where you're needed.
No!!!
The Cursed Forest is treacherous. I'll see you through. Stick close, don't get separated.
In the future, the Sanctuary will have rooms with various functions for people with different needs.
Hey, come see! The brand new Stable is complete!
I see, that makes sense. I'll bring the wounded soldiers over now.
There are too many patients. The nurses are overwhelmed. I'll continue treating patients in other wards for better efficiency.
The Raven's power is growing, we can enhance it even further!
I found a Raven Evolve Guide in the ruins, it should come in handy.
It's truly amazing. I'll try not to fall asleep during meditation.
These Raven Fruits will boost its power. Let's give them a try.
Let's hope all goes smoothly.
The Smelting Workshop continuously produces Gearstones, which can upgrade hero gear.
Before divination, select your preferred diviner—something wonderful might just happen!
I've restrained him to prevent injury. We can start treatment now.
A massive horde is heading this way. I'll hold them off. Reinforce the defenses!
The town has almost returned to its former state!
Celia, my dearest... Forgive me... I don't want to hurt any of you...
Celia, be patient. We should strengthen ourselves first to minimize risks.
Doctor, you can still venture into the depths of the forest via the [c][5b9000]Explorer's Camp[-][/c]! We are always there for you!
We can't just sit and wait in the town. We must eliminate the monsters and restore order and peace.
You must be the legendary doctor who has the cure, please help us... *cough cough*...
With the help of nurses', I can proceed to the ward to treat more patients. The efficiency is enhanced through teamwork.
Doctor, the patients need you more. I'll go and help the farmers.
Wonderful, the rats in the Sanctuary have all fled!
Something evil was in my head! But now, it's gone!
Here… take the signet ring. It's the very mark of the mayor's mantle—don't lose it.
I've been bitten! It hurts!
I won't let you down!
What's the plan, Doctor?
No! Don't say that!
Doctor, upgrading your Specialty Level grants attribute bonuses.
Doctor, we've established the Black Ops to investigate various incidents covertly.
The mayor gave his life to protect the town. We lay him to rest with heavy hearts and will forever remember his great deeds.
Legion Commander is an indispensable combat force for your city, enhancing your Might.
Ah...
Looks like the powder works. We could burn them to create a safe zone against the rats and the Blights.
Hold! The Giant Rat King is a powerful beast. To charge in now is folly — we'll be slaughtered!
Meditate... Feel your thoughts, imagine your are soaring into the sky...
Hope my beloved axe is still sharp! Time to work!
The mayor's wounds are too deep... I'm so sorry...
The Blueprint and materials are ready, Watt. What's next?
Don't worry. I'll do everything I can to heal the villagers and uncover the truth behind all this.
I can't wait to see the changes in the town. Watt, do you have any good ideas?
This one's mutating, but the wound is small, there's still hope.
Ravens love shiny things. It's probably just their instinct, but it's really helping us out.
There you are, the Giant Rat King!
He is the key to everything, but our priority right now is saving Celia…
Doctor, I've restrained Celia as you requested. She's in agony.
We'll need Timber to repair and reinforce it. Old Wood has been eager to get back to work since his recovery.
Stay calm, Celia. A single blade cannot win this fight. We need to rally everyone and fight as one!
Choose your preferred Specialty; you can swap it anytime later.
[c][5b9000]Complete Hero's Emergency to earn generous rewards[-][/c] and boost your overall strength.
On the battlefield, the higher the tier of the Soldier, the stronger they are. The faster the training, the quicker our Might increases!
A miracle... The pain's completely gone... We're saved! The town is saved!
Refresh quests for a chance to unlock higher-quality ones.
When your Specialty Skill reaches the designated level, you can unlock the corresponding Era Skill and receive generous rewards.
<sprite=53>
Active skills require manual activation and can be used in World and City.
Doctor, the Warlock risked his life to save me. Thank you for saving us.
We've upgraded enough wards. Time to claim our next star reward.
Am I too late...?
Spend Skill Points to upgrade skills and significantly boost your power.
Unclaimed rewards may be stolen by others. Coordinate with your alliance members to collect rewards together.
I'll stay here to assess the ward and plan future renovations.
Don't forget to complete daily quests—they'll help boost your Might!
There's still Timber left. Old Wood can renovate all these wards. Let's keep working!
This one's in bad shape. We can't wait for a bed.
We'll split up. You track down the Giant Rat King. I'll handle the Black Wizard. Stay safe. We'll meet again.
This antitoxin I developed may boost resistance to the rats and the Blight... but it's never been tested.
The town once had a valiant falcon, but it disappeared after Falcon Tower was destroyed.
In a world full of danger, there are new challenges and new opportunities every day.
Let me taste...
Don't be afraid. The Doctor's here, we no longer need to fear the rats. It's time to strike back!
Mayor, this herb may have side effects, but it's our only chance.
Handyman boosts tech development significantly, strengthening your capabilities from within.
No, those are human footsteps. Look, there! Someone's outside!
Doctor, we could use a receptionist to help manage incoming patients. That will save you a lot of time.
Hang on! I'm taking you back to the Sanctuary!
When the plague hit, many supplies were scattered across the wilderness. Whoever finds them, keeps them.
Help me... My arm is broken...
We should press the advantage and eliminate even stronger Blights!
Witchcraft proved powerless against such calamity.
From now on, this is your home.
(Whistles) Falcon, show us what's happening outside the town!
I can't wait!
You... You must be that doctor they talked about. My prayers have been heard!
<sprite=19>
Doctor, the food carriers were attacked by rats. They're badly hurt!
Doctor, come [c][5b9000]recruit[-][/c] powerful new heroes!
<sprite=60>
Look, what's that?!
Rats don't usually behave like this. Something's driving them.
Defeat isn't the end. Get stronger and try again!
They are wounded, not infected. Sending them to the Sanctuary might risk a plague infection.
Please take me in and let me assist you!
The Notice Board is up, Doctor. Head over and recruit some assistants.
Doctor, these rewards are quite tempting. Why not dispatch the caravan now?
Thank you, Doctor. I'll get back to work in the farm. I won't let you down!
We're still too slow... I need assistants who can treat patients independently, using my methods.
You're right. We need to enhance our strength.
It's probably the sound of rats scurrying away.
The Sanctuary's resource reserves are running low. We need to gather more resources.
We have to reclaim the farmland from the rats to restart food production.
Thank you for your efforts, Watt. This will greatly enhance the healing speed of our soldiers.
Please [c][5b9000]claim your rewards before building the Explorer's Camp[-][/c].
I will lead the fight. First, we must clean up the battlefield.
Doctor, we stand with you and your company. Together, we will save this world.
May fortune favor you!
The Explorer's Camp is your key base for exploring the Cursed Forest. Explorers can also gather all kinds of valuable resources for you.
Doctor, upgrading the Training Grounds allows you to train advanced soldiers, further strengthening your troop.
If we want more soldiers, we'll need to build Training Grounds.
This caravan's quality is modest—try refreshing it, Doctor. You might get something better!
The farmers haven't recovered yet. Heal them at the Sanctuary so they can work in the fields.
It's time to rebuild the Barracks and muster our own army!
Thank you for your help, Doctor. I will serve you from now on!
You... You must be that doctor they talked about. My prayer is heard! God sent you to help me!
Don't get me wrong. We're here to help. Hang in there, the Doctor will cure you.
I've been trapped here for days. I almost gave up... Thank you!
All the ingredients are in the storage. I need to prepare the medicine and get it to the patient at once.
Healing takes some time, and once completed, I can get healthy soldiers from the Infirmary.
Good heavens! That's the biggest rat I've ever seen!
Maintain this progress, and we can surely restore the world to its former glory.
The Blight around the town have been eliminated. We did it!
Piece of cake! But the lumberyard's been chewed to bits by the rats. You'll have to drive them off first.
Doctor, our soldiers are ready and awaiting your orders!
Doctor, I'm the best builder in town. I can modify the Sanctuary and build a massive brazier!
Sorry I'm late! Leave this big guy to me!
From now on… it's all on you, Doctor...
Doctor, survivors are lining up at the Notice Board, eager to help. Go have a look.
The equipment at the contact station is still functional. We can reach others.
Damn it! Get lost, filthy rats!
Great, our town remains unharmed!
These are symptoms of the plague.
Stay calm and prepare to defend!
A large horde of Blight is advancing towards our town!
Some quests are of great value, and we must act quietly to avoid detection.
Doctor, the town guards have detected an anomaly!
Doctor, you said the rats avoid you. Perhaps the powder you carry can fight this infection.
I must find a way... I won't let anyone else suffer as my father did.
The old blacksmith just mentioned that many materials were lost in the Cursed Forest. Let's go retrieve them.
I-I see...
When my prayer can't purge the evil, I prefer to try a more hands-on approach.
There are tools in the Builder's Hut. Use them to speed up the construction!
Why an axe?
There's an abandoned Gear Workshop in town where you can craft new weapons!
The crop yield is too low, we need real farmers.
Never lose hope, we can heal you.
Looks like… praying can't stop the plague… Has god forsaken us?
Wow! This is the finest caravan yet!
Doctor, Celia's condition has stabilized!
Good tools for the tough jobs. Our strength has grown.
Hold on, the town is just ahead!
Doctor, we've organized an elite squad to carry out Covert Operations.
Just one more step, and our town will be restored to its former glory.
Clear out the abandoned prayer room and convert it into a ward. That's where patients can be treated.
The towns outside have been destroyed, and we found some valuable Curios in the ruins.
After recovery, patients need nutrition and infection prevention, and the Herbal Canteen is established for this purpose.
So it's you, the mastermind behind all this! I won't let you get away with it! William, let's move!
We just need to make use of it to develop more useful technologies.
This was once a favorite place for scholars, where they could focus on their research.
I hear you're the best lumberjack in town. Can you help us repair the ward?
I can feel it... Something evil is trying to take over... Kill me... please...
It's too dangerous here. Leave the fighting to me!
That was the last of our rations. If we don't get more supplies, we'll starve before we fall ill.
Through the Explorer's Camp, you may eliminate monsters in the Cursed Forest and [c][5b9000]gather precious resources[-][/c].
Let's clean up the prayer room and turn it into a ward.
In the Arena, fights are controlled and no real harm will be caused. There will be rewards for each challenge.
Don't lose hope. There's medicine in the Sanctuary. Come with me.
Thank you... Thank you all... *cough*
His injuries aren't severe. Take him back to town at once.
More stars means faster development of the town!
Don't say anything. Save your energy. We're here to help you.
Throw herbs into the brazier and light it. They hate the smell!
Leave the search to us, you focus on planning the Ward renovation.
*Cough*... You all...
We can make good use of the Falcon Tower to complete various quests on the world map and earn rewards!
The world outside the town is filled with deadly monsters. Fortunately, you offered help...
The wounded need our help. Let's move now!
Doctor... I remember now. The Giant Rat King... it bit me! Am I... still alive?
Listen, that's the sound of rats gnawing wood. I even saw a shadowy figure among them last time...
It's fantastic to boost our power without wasting resources!
This statue must possess extraordinary power!
This is the falcon that once protected the town! Its keen eyes can help us find useful information!
We've unlocked new star rewards, so come and claim them now.
Looks like… praying can't stop the plague… Has god forsaken us?
They smell amazing.
The Raven can rest here and show up whenever we need it.
It's collecting coins inside the Sanctuary for us! What an amazing creature!
Interesting idea. Let's give it a try.
You can also participate in the alliance caravan transport for richer rewards.
Huh? The Raven is flying toward the Sanctuary. Let's follow it.
Doctor, a swarm of rats suddenly attacked! The townsfolk couldn't even put up a fight...
Watt foresaw this! Here is a new blueprint!
Test it on me. At least that's what I can do to protect our people.
We can't leave it behind. There are some herbs in the forest that can restore its strength!
It came to repay the kindness. It saved us.
Now, please assign them a job.
At your command, Doctor.
It's incredible. I feel like I've become a Raven!
Oh no! It's an ambush!
Doctor, Stellar and Hastar observed the stars last night and discovered unusual phenomena.
Thank you for saving us! Whenever you need me, I'll be there.
With your help, we can speed up the training process of our troops.
Oh no! The Sanctuary's surrounded.
Marlena is right. The Black Wizard's influence has spread worldwide with the plague.
Doctor, the forests near the town have all been reclaimed!
Follow the "Quest Guide" to quickly build the "Explorer's Camp".
We must keep advancing to protect more people! Come, let's stride toward a brighter future.
Thank you... I'll never leave your side again.
It's over. The nightmare is over. You're safe now.
Doctor, why don't we send the wounded soldiers to the Sanctuary for treatment?
It felt like... a long dream... In the dream, I wanted to hurt everyone...
Someone has joined us.
For some risky quests, you will need to dispatch qualified heroes.
Y… you… are you also sent by the Black Wizard? Cut the nonsense and get on with it.
It's safe now. I've sent the injured soldiers to the Sanctuary for treatment.
Pay attention to the quest time. Seek help from other alliance members to reduce the risk!
Doctor, science can snatch those forsaken by the gods back from death's grasp.
In harsh conditions, we can practice against each other to gain experience.
The Falcon Tower is complete, and the falcon has returned.
Doctor! There are Blights up ahead!
The wards just keep expanding… Even I sometimes would get lost.
Find the Blueprint or materials, and you can come to me anytime.
Ugh, they're so heavy... I'll definitely get some help next time.
Do you know why I saved this place for last? Because this is where my hatred first took root...
These Antitoxins can empower Heroes. Try them now.
However, the Blueprint and materials I carried were lost during the escape... I need to retrieve them.
After [c][5b9000]moving patients to the emergency ward[-][/c], move medicine there to commence emergency treatment. [c][5b9000]The more medicine moved, the faster the healing speed[-][/c].
We have more tasks ahead. Let's check them out first.
Who are you?
Doctor, let me join to express my gratitude.
The rats destroyed my hometown. I've been attacked by rats and Blights on my way here...
The knowledge recorded on these pages can lead to unique research outcomes that will benefit us.
Don't worry. I'll do my best. I'll take you to the Sanctuary.
You might be attacked during the quest, so stay alert!
Completing higher-quality events yields greater rewards.
Standard treatment isn't working. This is not a usual plague. It's like someone's cursed him.
Thank you so much... I was just searching for some brewing spices when I encountered these monsters.
I'd love to invite you to the Tavern to relax, but it's been destroyed by the rats. I don't know when it will be rebuilt.
Let's hope the plague hasn't reached here yet...
Could Celia and the mayor be...?
Each hero can escort only one caravan at a time. Consider assigning high-Might heroes to protect high-quality caravans.
Once the Tavern is repaired, you can [c][5b9000]recruit heroes and survivors[-][/c] to enhance your strength.
That's great! Let's take down that monster! Then we can bring Celia home!
Keep giving her the Antidote. She will recover!
We will have to find some rare materials. We'll need the falcon's help.
Doctor, the caravan arrived at its destination. We've earned quite a reward!
Great, we're no longer isolated!
Thank you for your help. I apologize for the misunderstanding.
Regular medicine isn't working... We need to prepare a special remedy for him now.
Test it on me then!
You're safe now. Come out, quick.
Leave construction to me! I'll make sure the Sanctuary is sturdy and good looking!
These are the Black Wizard's tracks. He and the Giant Rat King went separate ways.
The aroma of fresh grain...! Soon, we'll never have to worry about food again.
I've read about the Raven, evolving it will drastically boost its power.
Doctor, please help Celia! She's badly hurt!
The noise drew the monsters in! Quick, follow me!
Perhaps the falcon has found a new home. Maybe rebuilding the Falcon Tower will bring it back.
Yes, his building skills were far greater than most of us.
That old Lumber Depot was built by the late mayor himself…
This is the power of science and knowledge. I'll harness it to usher in a new era.
Excellent. That helps a lot!
You've thought of everything. Together we can overcome any threat!
The treatment only alleviates the symptoms. A patient will need to keep taking medicine to be fully cured.
To quickly raise your Specialty Level, tap the Upgrade button to see how to earn EXP.
Preparations are complete. Now, let's upgrade the Sanctuary!
We can make it even better and more beautiful.
Huh? I think I hear footsteps outside...
Heal the patients to recruit them.
Doctor, with this statue, you can uncap your level cap and ascend to greater heights.
Let's go. There are hungry mouths to feed.
I will cure you, Celia. We just need to gather enough antidote to get you back to normal!
Upon quest completion, we'll return with valuable spoils.
Gather enough resources and follow the blueprint, we will surely repel the enemy!
Now it's sturdier than ever. Excellent!
I've given her medicine. It will slow down the mutation, but it's not a cure.
Splendid battle! Those Blights didn't stand a chance!
We must take good care of the survivors. That's the mayor's last wish. Everyone, let's give it our all!
The Pharmacy's supplies are depleting too quickly. I can't carry that many herbs just by myself.
With more space, we can now take in more patients.
We can start the construction! The new treatment method will surely amaze you!
This place is in ruins. It's unrecognizable. Let's rebuild the lumberyard first!
Great! Now we don't have to worry about rats chewing through the walls.
This is the Arena leaderboard, where generous rewards are distributed weekly based on Arena rankings.
We've categorized these events so you can easily plan your next move.
We no longer need to fear Blight attacks! Let's keep moving!
Doctor, we are all set!
I feel warm, this will surely help those patients.
*Cough... I...
This is a race against death. We need more wards to increase efficiency.
Don't worry, I'll get you out of here now.
There are so many of them. It seems they are deliberately preventing us from obtaining the precious Herbs!
Looks like the Antidote only slowed the mutation. We must find the cure as soon as possible.
Behold my greatest creation! Your petty tricks are nothing before it!
Damn it! The flames from the powder don't work on this thing!
Watt foresaw everything! We can speedup construction to rapidly develop the town.
I want you to watch this world burn, and then die in despair!
No problem. The renovation plan is entirely in your hands.
They won't make it to the ward. We need to treat them now!
Doctor, you can perform 1 divination daily at each of 2 Diviners to earn different types of rewards.
We can convert the Sanctuary's nave into a Pharmacy. The nun can manage the daily distribution of medicine.
I... I'm going to turn into a Blight... aren't I...?
It's surprising to be able to read books when resources are so scarce.
What's that?!
The caravan may encounter dangers en route. You can dispatch a hero to escort it without affecting your normal march queue.
The rats just keep coming!
We need more herbs! If the flame dies, the Blights will devour this place.
The others are taking shelter in the Sanctuary. Follow me.
I found my grandmother's herbal bath recipe and wanted to gather materials to renovate the Ward, but was nearly killed by Blight.
The Sanctuary isn't strong enough. To expand the safe zone, we must upgrade it.
We're survivors from the capital. The world's overrun by rats.
Doctor, the Sanctuary is understaffed and can't treat all the patients in time.
Is anyone in the Sanctuary? Please, we need help!
In preparation, they've carefully divined your fortune.
Thank you for saving me. Please let me help you.
Select a quest and dispatch eligible heroes. You may claim rewards in a short while!
Every time we gather enough stars, we'll unlock new rewards.
With everyone's trust and support, we are sure to overcome all difficulties!
Doctor, you earn 1 Skill Point with each upgrade.
Feel and become one with the Raven. That will help us harness its power!
Great! Once the brazier is lit, everyone in the Sanctuary will be safe.
Doctor, many townsfolk are willing to participate in the construction, so please assign them to work.
I miss my old pal, Watt the Builder. With his help, we can easily build a nice Lumberyard.
These caravans help us transport supplies and earn generous rewards.
Great idea. We'll need to collect more herbs to keep the fire burning.
These supplies are essential for our town. Gather as many as you can!
Heroes conduct covert investigations during quests. However, they can still participate in other events simultaneously.
We need to collect more stars to help renovate the Sanctuary and prevent the rats from attacking it.
Doctor, preparations for upgrading the Sanctuary are done, but you're still short on the required resources.
We can't sit and wait. The best defense is a good offense!
Help...
You can focus on treatment. I'll take care of the new patients.
What happened to this town?!
Don't worry, we have the best builders. Leave the repairs to them.
You did well, Celia. Let's begin. Everyone, stay alert!
Maybe this is the key to stopping the mutation.
Behind you!
Doctor... the town and Celia... I'm counting on you...
So, the Blight... they were once human...
Father!!!
We have to expand the Sanctuary and build more wards.
There's not enough room for everyone. We're missing the critical window for treatment.
Help me!!!
Someone is calling for help over there!
It's... the Raven I once saved.
We've got enough Timber. Let's get that ward repaired.
This is the first Antidote. Let's try it on Celia.
Doctor, the soldiers are assembled at the barracks, awaiting orders.
I brewed an herbal elixir with unique effects. It has a distinct flavor and boosts immunity.
Thank you for saving me. I'd like to return the favor, but my weapon was damaged in battle.
Remember to come to me when you are wounded.
I'm alive! Thank you so much!
I'm surprised that you escaped from my trap! Well, then you can die here with them!
<sprite=3>
<sprite=3>
A huge pile of Timber is ready. Come collect it!
The rats have wrecked the ward. It's no longer usable.
I've never seen symptoms like these! We have to defeat the Giant Rat King and study it!
The soldiers defended our town with their lives. It's my honor to help them!
The new batch of food hasn't arrived yet. Did something happen? I'd better go check.
Doctor, you may earn stars through upgrading the wards, and stars will enhance your overall strength.
Please proceed to the Ward and lie down to wait for treatment.
Since the Plague spread, more and more people have turned to science as the cure for disease.
Doctor, leave this area and Celia to us. You focus on finding ingredients for the cure.
All medicine must be stored separately. Time to move some into the Pharmacy.
Doctor, by providing enough Grain, you may recruit suitable assistants.
I can defeat the Blight, but not this plague. The town has been in chaos since the mayor fell ill.
Doctor, use the pulpit as your desk. People will line up here to see you.
I think I hear them coming. You guys hurry up. I'll hold them off!
Thank goodness you're alright!
Exactly, we can use surplus Epigraph Shards to evolve the Raven.
The book states that besides the Raven Enhancement guide, Epigraph Shards can also be used as materials to evolve the Raven.
They left many gifts, including valuable Gearstones, which will enhance our strength.
Moreover, the statue grants you Specialties and Specialty Skills—choose the ones that suit you best.
What a magnificent statue! Doctor, you are our greatest leader and this world's savior
Doctor... I don't want to become a Blight, I don't want to hurt you...
You can [c][5b9000]recruit an Emergency Nurse[-][/c]. She will greatly ease your burden.
Caravan departed! Wait for the reward.
Over time, we can gain some research Speedups, which help us advance our research progress.
Raven Essence and fruits can enhance our Raven's Stats.
There are always risks. If discovered by others, our rewards may be plundered.
To switch Specialties, tap the Reset button.
We've prepared Antitoxin, which not only heals patients but also helps our heroes.
